caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate shown from both a top-down and side perspective. The plate is decorated with a symmetrical floral pattern featuring large, five-petaled flowers in pale pink with green centers, surrounded by green leaves and smaller buds. The flowers and leaves are outlined in a dark color, possibly blue or black. There are also stylized elements resembling brown pods or leaves interspersed around the rim. The background color of the plate is a pale greenish-beige. The rim of the plate is bordered with a thin blue line. The side view at the bottom of the drawing shows that the plate is shallow with a slightly upturned rim, and the floral pattern is visible on the interior surface, continuing the motif seen in the top view. The drawing is on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Plate
